Title: Login as user with valid credentials
Steps: 1. Open user login page. 2. Enter valid email and password. 3. Click login button. 4. Confirm successful login.

Title: Validate user sign-in process
Steps: 1. Open sign-in page. 2. Input valid credentials. 3. Submit and verify redirect to home dashboard.

Title: Reset user password as administrator
Steps: 1. Open user administration. 2. Select user and trigger password reset. 3. Verify reset email is sent and new password works.
